href.description:
Destination for the card's title link. Supply a text heading in the
header slot. A nonblank href takes precedence over interactive.

interactive.description:
Gives a titled card a primary button that emits ki-activate. Use href
for navigation. Keep other actions in separate controls in the card.

variant.description:
Surface treatment. Choose elevated for a raised panel, filled for a
tinted group or outlined for a bordered surface. Use default to follow
the theme's existing card treatment.

--ki-card-backdrop-filter.description: Complete card backdrop filter, off by default.

--ki-card-bg.description: color used by the card component for background (MarsUI Dashboard masters bind Surface/special/light-s0_dark-s1: white light / Dark/900 dark; #f9f9fa is the nested media panel, so the old s1 value inverted the surface hierarchy).

--ki-card-bg-image.description: Optional decorative image over the card background.

--ki-card-body-padding.description: dimension used by the card component for body padding.

--ki-card-border-color.description: color used by the card component for border color (MarsUI Outline/base_em hairline — painted on large Chart cards; Dashboard_info leaves width 0, which stays the default via ki.card.border-width).

--ki-card-border-width.description: dimension used by the card component for border width.

--ki-card-elevated-fg.description: Text on the elevated card background.

--ki-card-elevated-shadow.description: Resting shadow for an elevated card.

--ki-card-elevation.description: Card resting elevation: MarsUI elevation ramp level e1 (brief §5, drop 0/1/1/-0.5 in the scheme shadow color; replaces the migrated M2-era shadow).

--ki-card-fg.description: color used by the card component for foreground.

--ki-card-filled-fg.description: Text on the filled card background.

--ki-card-footer-padding.description: dimension used by the card component for footer padding.

--ki-card-gap.description: dimension used by the card component for gap (MarsUI Dashboard_info/Chart rhythm between regions 12px; material3 keeps zero via its override).

--ki-card-header-padding.description: dimension used by the card component for header padding.

--ki-card-hover-overlay.description: Pointer hover state layer on a primary-action card.

--ki-card-hover-shadow.description: Hover shadow of a primary-action card.

--ki-card-media-padding.description: dimension used by the card component for media padding (MarsUI Dashboard masters inset media panels 8px inline; material3 keeps full-bleed zero via its override).

--ki-card-media-radius.description: dimension used by the card component for slotted media corner radius (MarsUI nested media panel Radius/big_component/radius_sm 20px; formalizes the fallback ki-card.css already consumes).

--ki-card-outlined-bg.description: Page-coloured background for an outlined card.

--ki-card-outlined-border.description: Boundary colour for an outlined card.

--ki-card-outlined-border-width.description: Hairline width for an outlined card.

--ki-card-outlined-fg.description: Text on the outlined card background.

--ki-card-padding-block.description: dimension used by the card component for the surface block padding (16px carried by the card surface itself so stacked region paddings no longer double to 32px; formalizes the fallback ki-card.css already consumes).

--ki-card-radius.description: dimension used by the card component for radius (MarsUI card surfaces ride the big_component scale: Dashboard_info 400x128 binds radius_xs 16px; large Chart cards anchor radius_lg 28px).

--ki-card-title-family.description: Family used for a clickable card title.

--ki-density-space-scale.description: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-elevation-none.description: Flat surfaces carry no resting shadow.

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-motion-distance-sm.description: Motion travel distance sm (4px): small slide/settle offsets.

--ki-motion-duration-medium-1.description: M3 md.sys.motion.duration.medium1 (250ms). onmars: MarsUI moderate step (240ms, 2x the 120ms base).

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-title-1.description: semantic dimension for typography line height title 1.

--ki-typography-size-title-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size title 1.

component.description: A card surface for grouping related content, with an optional primary link or action.

ki-activate.description: Fires once when the user activates an action card by pointer or keyboard.

body.description: Body region wrapper around the default slot.

card.description: Card surface: background, border, radius, elevation and region gap.

trigger.description: Native link or action button in a clickable card’s heading.

href.description:
Destination for the card's title link. Supply a text heading in the
header slot. A nonblank href takes precedence over interactive.

interactive.description:
Gives a titled card a primary button that emits ki-activate. Use href
for navigation. Keep other actions in separate controls in the card.

variant.description:
Surface treatment. Choose elevated for a raised panel, filled for a
tinted group or outlined for a bordered surface. Use default to follow
the theme's existing card treatment.

slots.description: Body region for supporting text or arbitrary composed content.

footer.description: Closing region for actions such as `ki-button`; no dedicated actions slot exists in v1.

header.description: Title region. Supply one nonempty text heading at the surrounding document level for a clickable card.

media.description: Leading visual region for an image, video or illustration.
